ledger: 00:00-00:02: White and blue toothbrush held in the man's right hand (in mouth at 00:00-00:01, raised to eyebrow at 00:02).
00:03: Object in the man's right hand (and its reflection in the mirror) transforms into a black comb as he strokes his hair, without his hand ever leaving the frame or releasing the object.

00:04-00:09: Object in the man's right hand transforms back into the white and blue toothbrush as he lowers his hand to his eyebrow (00:04), mouth (00:05), and holds it near his cheek/mouth (00:06-00:09).

findings.invariant_violated: object identity / continuous chain of custody
findings.description: While continuously held in the man's right hand in plain view, the white and blue toothbrush morphs into a black comb as he moves his hand from his eyebrow to his hair at 00:03, then morphs back into the white and blue toothbrush at 00:04 as he lowers his hand.
